beats.summary: Toby describes a wilderness retreat camping trip he attended with branch managers, which Michael was not invited to.

evidence.snippet: Toby: I really didn't think I was going to have a good time, but I did. Totally did.
Pam: Ryan invited some of the branch managers and Toby into the woods for a "get to know you" weekend. Michael wasn't invited.

beats.summary: Michael expresses frustration about not being invited and his desire to go on a solo survival camping trip.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I'm sick of it Jim. I'm sick of this place.
Michael: I wanna do it myself. You know, I want to go and, and find out something about myself, I wanna get outta here.

beats.summary: Michael prepares for his solo wilderness survival trip with Dwight's help, taking only duct tape and a knife.

evidence.snippet: Michael: OK, I will only need two things. Roll of duct tape and a knife.

beats.summary: Michael announces he will take a personal day and leave Dwight in charge while he goes into the wilderness alone.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Dwight and I are going out. He will return later, but I will not.

beats.summary: Dwight humorously describes extreme measures he would take if he were a serial killer, while Michael plays along.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: First, I would remove your teeth and cut off your fingertips so you could not be identified.

beats.summary: Jim and Angela discuss consolidating multiple office birthday parties into one shared celebration.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Jim, we need to order a cake for Creed's birthday.
Jim: You know what, I have an idea. Why don't we just do one big shared party?
